scope: Diagnostic actual seven Game processes on one Windows machine using public relay; wall timing instrumentation. Not rendering FPS acceptance, not separate physical client machines, and not ABBA. Matching timer windows use process uptime12-32seconds before native disconnect.

metric_semantics.timers: inclusive monotonic wall milliseconds; nested scopes not additive; CPU process time is separate
metric_semantics.native_performance: Godot cached previous-window maxima, not per-frame distributions
metric_semantics.wire_bytes: encoded packet attempts; pacing queued_bytes counts only successful enqueue
metric_semantics.visual_counts: _flush_visual invocations, not proof that transport accepted each event batch
metric_semantics.frames: SceneTree process-signal intervals including preceding physics catch-up; not GPU-render timing
metric_semantics.cpu: full helper lifetime including startup/cleanup, not exact matched timer interval
